$description: Labeled action with primary, secondary outlined, and destructive appearances. Secondary and destructive colors use existing Moshi semantic roles.
name: Button

behavior.action: Invoke exactly once per activation; for asynchronous work prevent duplicate activation while loading.
behavior.pressed: Pressed uses each variant's hover background; no new pressed color token.
behavior.loading: Keep label width stable, show meaningful progress and set busy state. Disable duplicate submissions; do not imply completed work.
behavior.disabled: No interaction; disabled visuals alone do not convey non-availability.
behavior.icon: Optional icons support the label rather than replacing it; use approved icon sizes.

accessibility: Visible descriptive label; do not rely on color alone for destructive intent.
Web native button must set type=button unless used for form submission; support Space and Enter.
Focus indicator uses color.border.focus, with a contextual neutral contrast band where required.
When loading, expose accessible busy status and keep feedback understandable without animation.

web: Use semantic HTML controls, keyboard focus-visible, and 24×24 CSS px minimum targets; prefer more space for touch.
Retain browser zoom and allow labels to wrap or controls to grow.
Use <button>; do not simulate buttons with clickable generic elements.
ios: Respect 44pt minimum interactive hit area and Dynamic Type; prefer native Button/Control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility label/state APIs.
android: Respect 48dp minimum interactive target and nonlinear font scaling; prefer native Compose/View control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility semantics.
